content.value: The first cost of a small dam is expected to be \$3 milion. The annual (15) maintenance cost is estimated to be \$10,000 per year a \$35,000 outlay will be required for every 5 years. In addition an expenditure of \$5,000 in year 10 wili be required, increased by \$1,000 per year through year 20, after which it wili remain constant. If the dam is expected to last forever, what will be the capitalized cost at an interest rate of 15% per year?
